/            Filter Mode
?            Help
Ctrl-R       Refresh

Esc          Filter Reset
Shift-N      Sort Name
Shift-O      Sort Selected Column
Shift-S      Sort Status
a            Apply [dangerous]
c            Copy
d            Delete [dangerous]
e            Edit [dangerous]
key-272      Help
q            Filter Reset
